sources.entry: HomeBox (SysAdminsMedia) - Inventory and organization system built for the home user. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Go
Homebox | Inventory and organisation system for your home

summary.one_liner: HomeBox is a self-hostable inventory and organization system for home users, written in Go with SQLite and an embedded web UI.
summary.what_it_does: HomeBox lets you catalog household items and organize them into categories, locations, and tags, with support for custom fields on each item. It includes a search feature for finding items, image upload for identifying them, and document and warranty tracking. It also tracks purchase dates, prices, and maintenance schedules. The web UI is described as responsive for desktops, tablets, and phones. The README says it uses SQLite and an embedded Web UI so it is easy to deploy and back up. It is distributed as a Docker image, with rootless and hardened variants.
use_cases: organizing items by location and category
recording purchase prices and maintenance schedules
how_to_run: mkdir -p /path/to/data/folder && chown 65532:65532 -R /path/to/data/folder (for rootless or hardened image)

docker run -d --name homebox --restart unless-stopped --publish 3100:7745 --env TZ=Europe/Bucharest --env HBOX_AUTH_API_KEY_PEPPER=$(cat hbox.pepper) --volume /path/to/data/folder/:/data ghcr.io/sysadminsmedia/homebox:latest
notable: Single-container deployment with SQLite and an embedded web UI
Idle memory usage stated as under 50MB for the whole container
Rootless and hardened Docker image variants
Custom fields, categories, locations, and tags for items
Translations managed through a Weblate instance
caveats: Rootless and hardened images require manual data folder permission setup (UID 65532)
Requires generating and supplying an API key pepper value before first run
README does not describe platforms beyond Docker in the quick start
